description: netSendList builds its packet in a malloc block; bytes 1..3 and the record bytes the copy never writes hold malloc garbage in the original. The port sends 0 there.
path to resolution: A heap stand-in with a known fill would settle the original's bytes

description: S3List_addVoiceRx (ring add with a 0x64-byte VoiceRx payload through operator new and VoiceRx::ctor) is forwarded to the host, not ported.
path to resolution: Port the ring add once a VoiceRx/sound-object peer exists

description: netHandleControl's dialogs (TextView ctor, loadScript with 0x004e4680 + text ids, build, SEH teardown) are one DialogRun host call; the render flag word set on the first dialog's drop answer is not modelled.
path to resolution: Model the TextView screens in the UI port

description: netPoll passes GetPlayerName the size 0x100 by value; the original passes the address of a stack word holding 0x100.
path to resolution: None needed unless a real DirectPlay host is added
